_notes.roleSeparation: No address may appear in both `recyclers` and `auditors`. RECYCLER produces reports, AUDITOR authorises the payout; one key holding both is the treasury-drain path of docs/plan/security-audit-remediation.md section 3.1. script/ManageRoles.s.sol aborts if this file violates the rule, and addresses in `admins`/`emergency` must not appear in either operational list.
_notes.deployment: RecyReportDeploy is fresh-only: after the local token, endpoint and token owner are configured, its broadcast preparation automatically records all six planned report-stack addresses. Dry runs preserve this file; interrupted sends must retain the recorded values and Foundry artifacts for --resume. Standalone component scripts still require manual address recording.
_notes.fundWallets: ADVISORY ONLY. `recyclerFunds`/`auditorFunds` record the wallet each principal is expected to register; no script applies them. `RecyReport.setFundsWallet(address)` is self-service, so each principal must call it from its own key.
_notes.unlockDelay: 3600 on the local dev chain (the on-chain minimum: the Phase 2 implementation enforces MIN_UNLOCK_DELAY = 1 hour at BOTH initialize and setUnlockDelay, so 60 is no longer deployable). Local claim flows warp time anyway - script/PopulateRecyReport.s.sol warps unlockDelay + 300 automatically. Public networks use 86400.

_notes.deployment: RecyReportDeploy is fresh-only and automatically records all six planned Sepolia report-stack addresses during broadcast preparation; they are not live until every receipt succeeds. Dry runs preserve this file, and interrupted sends must retain the recorded values and Foundry artifacts for --resume. Standalone component scripts still require manual address recording.
_notes.fundWallets: ADVISORY ONLY. `recyclerFunds`/`auditorFunds` record each principal's intended wallet. `RecyReport.setFundsWallet(address)` is self-service; each principal must call it from its own key.
_notes.blessedAddresses: `contracts.reportImplementation` and `contracts.reportData` must identify fresh deployments. RecyReportProxyDeploy verifies the new factory uses that pair.
